response.sql: WITH rec AS (SELECT team_id, CAST(w AS REAL) / NULLIF(g, 0) AS win_rate FROM manager_half), team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(win_rate) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM rec GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_avg FROM team_stats) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_win_rate, t.record_count, t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_avg AS diff FROM team_stats t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
